# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 85 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 85 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_085_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9 — The Tower Is Built

**1** The twelve virgins were picking up stones, passing them through the gate, and handing them to the young men, who then fitted them into the tower. **2** Other figures — not the virgins — were hauling stones up from the depths below and bringing them. The deep was off to the left of the gate, where the virgins were standing. **3** Once all those stones had been placed, more were pulled up from below. **4** These stones came up on all sides and were fitted into the tower — perfectly smooth all around, locking in perfectly with the others. **5** They joined so seamlessly that the seams were invisible. The whole tower looked like it had been carved from a single piece of stone. **6** Then more stones came up from below — some mottled, some rough, some white, some mixed colors. The young men fitted all of these in as well. But many of them were pulled out and set aside, and many were thrown far away from the tower by the virgins themselves and left lying along the road. **7** Others that had been removed were taken back by the builders and set against the stone from the deep where they'd originally been cut — but they wouldn't fit. They were found to be useless for the construction. **8** "Do you see these stones?" he asked me. "Yes, Lord," I said. "The ones that have been thrown aside," he said, "will never become part of the tower." **9** Among the stones lying by the road, some were broken in half, some were cracked, some were chipped on every side, some were completely smashed to pieces, and some were untouched. Most of the untouched ones were waiting there for that place.

---

*PNEUMA renders the construction scene dynamically, with "locking in perfectly" and "carved from a single piece" to convey the seamless unity of the Church.*
